metaDescription: Distillation's configuration reference as specced: every feature independently toggleable via Mod Menu / Cloth Config or config/distillation.json.
title: Config
lede: Every option, as specced. All features are independently toggleable through Mod Menu / Cloth Config or config/distillation.json, created with defaults on first launch; /distillation reload re-reads it live. Change nothing and you get exactly the design defaults.

rows: Recipe recording, the ✦ toast, the recipes page, and vapor hints
Failed brews bottle Murky Draughts (off: invalid pairs simply don't brew)
Every player starts with the full recipes page
Copy a discovered recipe onto paper from the recipes page — a tradeable note
The recipe-less effect lines vanilla shipped
Fuel charges consumed per six-bottle pass
A comparator reads brew state — idle, brewing (bottle count), or done; off restores vanilla's container-fullness signal
Charge a water cauldron with a discovered potion, then dip arrows to tip them
Arrows tipped per dip; each dip spends one cauldron water level
Concentration and the both-dusts premium path
A beneficial splash/cloud you throw reaches only players and their pets
Fraction of drinkable duration a splash applies
blocks.note: Every toggle off means behaviorally untouched vanilla for that feature — the spec's standing contract.
